# TZ Taste

Free browser design reference studio by RawmWare. No AI runtime, credentials, or external service required.

Catalog: ./catalog.json
Source: https://github.com/rawmware/TZ-taste
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Each catalog record contains id, title, category, tags, notes, license, and a complete standalone HTML example in html.
Use notes to understand design intent; adapt the HTML to the user's project.
Users can export a Markdown brief and JSON backup. Personal references and preferences are local to their browser and are not publicly available to crawlers.
External reference links are inspiration, not permission to copy third-party assets.
